verses.text_en: And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga vidio sam drugu vojsku bojnih kola i ljude kako se na njima voze, dolazeći na vjetrovima s istoka i sa zapada prema jugu.

verses.text_en: And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.
verses.text_hr: Čuo se tutanj njihovih kola. Kad je nastao taj metež, sveti s neba opazili su ga, stupovi zemlje pomaknuli su se sa svojih mjesta, a njihov se zvuk u jednome danu čuo od jednoga kraja neba do drugoga.

verses.text_en: And they shall all fall down and worship the Lord of Spirits. And this is the end of the second Parable.
verses.text_hr: Svi će pasti ničice i pokloniti se Gospodaru duhova. To je kraj Druge prispodobe.
